old_title: How a Nigerian vendor survives on selling local street delicacy
new_title: How a Nigerian street food vendor built a life for herself and her family
old_text:
How a Nigerian vendor survives on selling local street delicacy
In Nigeria, okpa is a traditional delicacy mostly sold on the streets. Meet a woman who has been selling okpa for over twenty years. Despite the gruelling journey, Victoria has put her four children through school.
new_text:
How a Nigerian vendor survives on selling local street delicacy
Okpa is a beloved Nigerian street food that Victoria has been selling for over 20 years. Despite the gruelling journey, she kept going and has put her four children through school.
